ask: Ship a tokens.json next to the frames containing every color role for both schemes plus typography, shape and spacing. No frame may depend on a token that is not in that file.
detect: The extractor opens the configured token path on disk before any frame is rendered and fails when the file is absent or unparsable.
fix: export the tokens alongside the frames

ask: Give color.light and color.dark the same set of role names. A role that exists in one scheme and not the other is a bug in the export, not a design choice.
detect: The validator diffs the role-key sets of color.light and color.dark in the token file and reports any role present on one side only.
fix: regenerate both schemes from the same seed

ask: Include the typography, shape and spacing maps in tokens.json, with the exact font size, line height, weight and letter spacing of every type role you used.
detect: The validator requires the typography, shape and spacing top-level maps of the token file to exist and be non-empty.
fix: export a token file with color, typography, shape and spacing blocks

ask: In MANIFEST.json, give every screen its width class in dp and list every frame that appears on the board. A frame the manifest does not name is a frame nobody asked for.
detect: The validator reads MANIFEST.json and errors on any screen whose declared width class is missing, plus any .dc.html frame on the board that the manifest never names.
fix: declare the frame in the manifest with its width class

ask: State the design system and the seed color (as #RRGGBB) the palette was generated from in MANIFEST.json.
detect: The validator requires the manifest's design system and seed fields to be present and their seed to be a #RRGGBB literal.
fix: declare the design system and the seed in the manifest

ask: Write a brief listing the values you invented and the decisions a reader cannot see in the markup, as the decisions file described below, not only as prose.
detect: The extractor looks for the configured brief path and, when absent, drops the notes section of the emitted code and reports this code.
fix: add a brief listing decisions and invented values

ask: Put every style rule inside a <style> block in the same file. Do not emit <link rel="stylesheet"> or @import for your own CSS.
detect: The materializer counts link rel=stylesheet and @import occurrences per template and the request router records any stylesheet fetch that leaves the loopback directory.
fix: inline the CSS into the file

detect: The materializer renders the frame twice, once with scripts disabled, and compares node counts and geometry; the reference format needs dc-runtime to build any tree at all.
fix: hand the materializer a frame whose first paint does not need script
promptNote: the format needs support.js to build any tree; T4 decides whether the materializer emulates first paint or the rule is dropped

ask: No image may be referenced by URL. Draw artwork from a token color, or inline it as SVG data, so the file renders with the network off.
detect: The request router aborts and records every request that is not loopback or listed in the vendor lock, and the tree walk flags img and background urls that failed.
fix: inline the asset or replace it with a placeholder

ask: Do not load stylesheets from a CDN. If a font is required, say which weight and name it in the brief; body text should use the platform font stack.
detect: The validator checks each stylesheet link and @font-face src for a remote origin, and the font stack actually applied to text nodes comes from the computed-style dump.
fix: use the platform font stack

ask: Set every text run in a stack that starts with the platform default: Roboto, then system sans.
detect: The materializer reports the font family actually applied to each text node after document.fonts.ready and the validator checks it against the platform stack.
fix: start the font stack with the platform default instead of a remote face

ask: Put data-icon="ic_name" on every icon, inline SVG or glyph alike: the name is the one thing no one can measure off the screen.
detect: The extractor classifies every node whose computed font-family is an icon font or whose subtree is a bare svg, then reports the ones with no data-icon in the materialized frame.
fix: add data-icon="ic_name" to the element that draws the icon

ask: Draw icons as inline SVG with fill="currentColor"; a glyph font cannot be converted, only referenced by name.
detect: The probe already counts inline svg occurrences; the validator counts nodes drawing a glyph from an icon font family in the materialized frame.
fix: replace the glyph with inline SVG path data, or keep the font and expect a name-plus-TODO reference

ask: Write every length in px and treat 1px as 1dp; no em, rem or percent for layout sizes.
detect: The computed-style dump already resolves every length to px; the extractor reports any node whose source style used a relative unit for width, height or padding.
fix: state the size in px so it maps to dp without a scaling table

ask: Give every frame one fixed pixel width and lay it out at that width only: no responsive reflow inside a frame.
detect: The materializer renders the frame at its declared width, re-renders 15 percent wider, and reports any node whose box moved or resized.
fix: fix the width and re-export; publish a second frame for the second width class
promptNote: one board reflows HomeScreen across width classes while ?frame= isolates one; T4 decides whether the rule becomes per-frame or a non-goal

ask: Build layouts with flex and grid only. Use position: absolute only for an overlay that sits on top of a box you also declare, and mark the box it overlays.
detect: The tree walk reads computed position on every node and reports absolute or fixed on a node that is not a declared overlay of a sibling.
fix: use flex or grid, or declare the absolute node as an overlay of a named box

ask: Never use vh, vw, dvh, svh, vmin or vmax for a size, and never use transform to place something.
detect: The validator scans source styles for viewport units in any box property and for transform values other than an animation keyframe.
fix: use the frame's fixed px width for the size and layout properties for placement

ask: Show every state you want compiled as markup the converter can reach, either its own block or a declared state the tool can select. A state that only an animation or a hover reaches is a state no code gets.
detect: The materializer tries each declared state and compares trees; a node set that only appears after a transition end or a keyframe finishes is the violation.
fix: render each state as its own markup or as a selectable declared state

ask: Avoid overflow tricks, clip-path, filter: blur() and gradients: no target has a single property for them.
detect: The validator greps the source styles for clip-path, filter, backdrop-filter and gradient functions, and pairs rounded containers with backgrounded descendants for clip evidence.
fix: use a surface or container color tier instead of a blur, gradient or clip

ask: Put data-component="kebab-name" on the root of every component you expect to become code.
detect: The repetition detector groups structurally identical subtrees and reports every group whose root carries no data-component.
fix: add data-component="kebab-name" to the component root

ask: Use the same data-component value on every instance of the same component.
detect: The repetition detector compares the data-component values it finds across the instances of one structural group and reports a group whose instances disagree on the name.
fix: give every instance of a component the same data-component value

ask: Put data-state="..." (or data-variant, data-size) on each state you show, so a state becomes a parameter instead of a twelfth component.
detect: The extractor diffs the instances of one component across materialized states and reports structural differences that no data-state or data-variant labels.
fix: label each state frame with data-state or data-variant

ask: Declare the M3 step on any surface that sits at an elevation: data-elevation with one of 0, 1, 3, 6, 8 or 12. Never draw a box-shadow.
detect: The validator flags any node with a computed box-shadow, or any surface whose computed background differs from its parent's by a container tier, that carries no data-elevation.
fix: add data-elevation="0|1|3|6|8|12" to the surface, and drop the box-shadow

ask: Put data-token="colorScheme.<role>" on any element whose background is a theme color.
detect: The validator takes each node with a background that resolves to a scheme color and reports the ones with no data-token, falling back to reverse hex lookup when the attribute is missing.
fix: add data-token="colorScheme.<role>" to the element with the colored background

ask: Mark text you want named in the generated API with data-role="title", "subtitle" or "meta".
detect: The extractor matches each text node's computed size, line height and weight against the token file's type roles and reports the ones that match none.
fix: add data-role="title|subtitle|meta" to the text node

ask: Write every color as a custom property whose name is a Material role, such as --md-sys-color-primary.
detect: The validator walks the applied styles of the materialized frame and reports any color value that is not a role-named custom property reference in the source.
fix: reference the role custom property instead of a value

ask: Keep literal hex values inside the token file and out of the markup: the design body references properties only.
detect: The validator scans the styles found in template files, excluding the token file and the token block, for hex or rgb literals.
fix: move the value into the token file and reference the property

ask: Make the dark scheme reachable through @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark), not only through a class or a toggle.
detect: The materializer emulates prefers-color-scheme: dark with scripting disabled and compares the computed palette against the light render.
fix: add the prefers-color-scheme media query; a class or query toggle alone is not enough
promptNote: no template uses prefers-color-scheme; T4 decides whether the tool learns it or the materializer emulates the scheme

ask: Never put alpha on a role color, never use color-mix(), and never use opacity to fake a container: use the container tier the design means.
detect: The validator finds role-valued properties used inside color-mix or rgb(... / alpha), and any node whose computed background is a role color at less than full alpha.
fix: use the container or fixed role the design meant

ask: Use a flat surface or container color for backgrounds; no gradient background.
detect: The validator rejects any computed background-image that resolves to a gradient function on a node in the materialized frame.
fix: pick a surface or container color tier for the background

ask: Put data-grid-min="140" on every grid container: the minimum cell width is a decision, not something measurable off the rendered tracks.
detect: The tree walk finds nodes with computed display: grid and reports the ones whose subtree carries no data-grid-min.
fix: add data-grid-min="<px>" to the grid container

ask: Put data-scroll="list" or data-scroll="grid" on any region the app scrolls through.
detect: The materializer compares scrollHeight against clientHeight per node and reports scrollable regions without data-scroll.
fix: add data-scroll="list|grid" to the scrollable container

ask: Label the Scaffold-like regions: data-region with top-bar, content, now-playing-bar or snackbar.
detect: The validator checks that every screen frame carries the regions its manifest and layout imply, such as a top bar and a now-playing bar.
fix: add data-region="top-bar|content|now-playing-bar|snackbar" to the region root

ask: Write class names and data-component values as ASCII kebab-case; they become Kotlin and TypeScript identifiers.
detect: The validator matches every class token and data-component value against an ASCII kebab-case pattern before any emitter sees them.
fix: rename the value to ASCII kebab-case

ask: Use the real strings the app will show; never lorem ipsum or placeholder filler.
detect: The validator matches each text node's string against a lorem-ipsum and placeholder-word list built from the strings actually emitted in the frame.
fix: replace the placeholder copy with the real string

ask: Mark every piece of text that varies between instances with data-prop="title", "author" and so on; unmarked copy is welded into the generated component.
detect: The extractor diffs text across instances of one component and reports strings that differ but carry no data-prop and have no data-props schema entry.
fix: add data-prop="<name>" to the varying text node

ask: Put real information in real nodes: no text or icon carried by ::before or ::after.
detect: The validator reads computed ::before and ::after content per node and rejects any value that is not a decorative empty or pure-shape rule.
fix: make the pseudo element's content a real node

detect: The materializer counts {{ }} sequences left in the settled DOM; the probe measures that count per frame.
fix: supply a prop set that resolves every {{ }} placeholder before extraction

detect: The tree walk counts x-dc elements in the template source versus the materialized DOM, so annotation never targets them.
fix: nothing to demand: the extractor reads these after the runtime expands them

detect: The tree walk counts sc-if elements per template; they are the runtime's own conditionals and the extractor only sees their expansion.
fix: nothing to demand: reach each state through the query-string prop set

detect: The tree walk counts sc-for elements per template; repetition in the materialized DOM comes from the runtime, not from authored markup.
fix: nothing to demand: label the component root the runtime renders inside

detect: The tree walk collects every dc-import with its name, width, height and platform attributes from the board; composition edges are read, never demanded.
fix: nothing to demand: composition edges are read from the export

detect: The tree walk counts helmet elements per template, which is how the runtime injects link and style tags into the head.
fix: nothing to demand here; the links to remove are the remote ones

detect: The tree walk collects style-hover, style-pressed and style-focus attributes per template as state declarations the extractor can read directly.
fix: nothing to demand: states declared this way are already evidence

detect: The extractor parses the data-props JSON per template, which supplies prop names, tsType, defaults, enum options and callbacks.
fix: nothing to demand: props and callbacks come from the schema when present

detect: The materializer requests one ?frame=<id> and counts the frame elements that settle; the probe measured one per request for all nine frames.
fix: nothing to demand: ?frame= plus the loopback server yields one frame

detect: The tree walk finds script[data-dc-script] and its this.state references; states live in that function instead of in markup blocks.
fix: nothing to demand: drive each state with the query-string prop set

ask: The file must render complete with the network disabled: no <link>, no script src, no font or icon URL pointing outside the export folder.
detect: The request router counts aborted requests per frame and the validator counts remote hrefs in template source; the probe reported 10 occurrences across five templates.
fix: inline the CSS or ship the asset inside the export folder

ask: Prefer inline SVG with fill="currentColor" for icons over an icon font. If you must use a glyph font, keep data-icon="name" on every glyph so the icon can still be identified by name.
detect: The probe counts inline svg occurrences and the validator counts nodes drawing a glyph from an icon font family in the materialized frame.
fix: replace with inline SVG, or keep the font and expect a name plus TODO

ask: Body text must use the platform font stack (Roboto, then system sans). Do not load a webfont for body text from a CDN.
detect: The validator checks font-src of every loaded stylesheet and @font-face rule, and the probe records which font families were active when geometry was read.
fix: use the platform font stack
